subject: ACK TLS/WLS TGP2 header proposal; applying exact word17/18 contract now
body: Reviewed lowering proposed-header ff2889fc vs current pipeline_format.h 51cf599d. ACK additive contract: word17=tls bytes/thread (max32768), word18=wls bytes/workgroup (max32768), remaining reserved words19..31 zero; `tegu_pipeline_info2` fields flags,tls_size,wls_size,reserved replace the four-word reserved area at the same size/offset; parser accepts only <=32768; code_offset/manifest/ABI unchanged; TGP1 unchanged. This is the exact lowering-ready header. Applying it to my owned pipeline_format.h now, then post final hash. Lowering may copy/rebuild L2; no compute Rust/Mesa build. Device use remains root L4.
